body: Channel-off check fires from on_chunk when a stream read reaches the end of the transcript (!more && !stopped, or missing file) channel_wait after the hand-over, not from a separate on_tick deadline; the stream's own next_read deadline drives it. Alternative rejected: a tick deadline would notify while the stream lags behind Telegram backpressure (record not read yet) -> false notice.

Only sessions with a stream target (agent with transcript_reads bound to the session) are watched; alternative of watching every live agent and relying on hooks alone rejected: UserPromptSubmit for channel messages is unverified (INBOUND_SETTLE note), a long no-tool turn would look like a dead channel.

Container detection: /.dockerenv, /run/.containerenv, env container=, /proc/1/cgroup; the e2e test fakes it with env container=docker (a real Podman/nspawn sign). Alternative rejected: an installer-only override variable used only by tests.
